(1/3)x + ay = b
2x + cy = 5d
If the system has infinitely many solutions, what is the value of b/d?
problem.notes: Infinitely-many-solutions means the constants scale by the same factor as the leading coefficients: 2/(1/3)=6, so 5d=6b, giving b/d=5/6. Two arithmetic rows suffice; there is no data to fit, so any regression is unnecessary machinery.

result.forbiddenReason: used a regression where arithmetic (or a written ratio) suffices

solution.structure: two linear equations; system has infinitely many solutions → the two equations are proportional (all coefficients and constants share same ratio)
